evidence: Liv. 1.35.8: loca dīvīsa patribus equitibusque, ubi spectācula sibi quisque facerent: forī appellātī (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Lewis & Short s.v. forus: “a row of seats in the Circus”. The word is masculine, not the forum of the market place.

sources: Lewis & Short: forus
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 44, 45.
